description: Process an automotive repair work order from vehicle intake through diagnostic, estimate, authorization, repair, quality check, and invoicing.

steps.description: Receive a vehicle at the shop and log the customer complaint, vehicle information, and initial observations.

inputs.name: customer-complaint
inputs.desc: What the customer says is wrong with the vehicle

inputs.name: vehicle-info
inputs.desc: Year, make, model, mileage, VIN, and license plate

outputs.name: intake-record
outputs.desc: Logged vehicle information, customer complaint, and initial observations

outputs.name: work-order-number
outputs.desc: Assigned work order number for tracking

process: Record the vehicle year, make, model, mileage, VIN, and license plate.
Log the customer complaint in their own words.
Note any visible damage, warning lights, or obvious symptoms during the walkaround.
Assign a work order number and set the status to awaiting diagnosis.

steps.description: Perform a diagnostic inspection to identify the root cause of the customer complaint.

inputs.name: intake-record
inputs.desc: Vehicle information and customer complaint

inputs.name: work-order-number
inputs.desc: Work order number for this job

outputs.name: diagnostic-findings
outputs.desc: Root cause analysis with supporting evidence (codes, measurements, visual inspection)

outputs.name: recommended-repairs
outputs.desc: List of repairs needed to resolve the complaint

process: Pull diagnostic trouble codes if applicable.
Perform the relevant inspection (visual, road test, component test, fluid analysis).
Identify the root cause and any related issues discovered during inspection.
Document the findings with measurements, photos, or code data.

steps.description: Build the repair estimate with parts, labor, and any sublet work.

inputs.name: diagnostic-findings
inputs.desc: What was found during diagnostic inspection

inputs.name: recommended-repairs
inputs.desc: List of repairs needed

outputs.name: repair-estimate
outputs.desc: Itemized estimate with parts, labor hours, labor rate, sublet costs, and total

outputs.name: parts-list
outputs.desc: Parts needed with part numbers, sources, and prices

process: Look up the labor guide time for each repair operation.
Price the parts from the supplier catalog or inventory.
Add shop supplies, environmental fees, and any sublet charges.
Calculate the total and organize by priority (needed now vs. recommended).

steps.description: Present the estimate to the customer and get authorization to proceed with the repair.

inputs.name: repair-estimate
inputs.desc: The itemized repair estimate

inputs.name: work-order-number
inputs.desc: Work order number for reference

outputs.name: authorization-record
outputs.desc: Customer authorization with approved line items, date, and method of approval

outputs.name: approved-repairs
outputs.desc: The specific repairs authorized by the customer

process: Contact the customer by their preferred method (phone, text, email).
Explain the findings and the recommended repairs in plain language.
Walk through the estimate line by line if the customer has questions.
Record the authorization (verbal, text, or signature) with date and time.

steps.description: Track the repair through execution, parts arrival, and technician assignment.

inputs.name: approved-repairs
inputs.desc: Repairs authorized by the customer

inputs.name: parts-list
inputs.desc: Parts needed for the approved repairs

outputs.name: repair-log
outputs.desc: Record of work performed, parts installed, and technician hours

outputs.name: completion-status
outputs.desc: Whether the repair is complete, pending parts, or has complications

process: Order any parts not in stock and track the delivery.
Assign the job to a technician and log the start time.
Perform the authorized repairs per the service procedure.
Record the actual parts used and labor time.

steps.description: Verify the repair resolved the original complaint and no new issues were introduced.

inputs.name: repair-log
inputs.desc: Record of work performed

inputs.name: diagnostic-findings
inputs.desc: Original diagnostic findings for comparison

outputs.name: quality-check-result
outputs.desc: Pass or fail with notes on what was verified

outputs.name: road-test-notes
outputs.desc: Observations from the post-repair road test if applicable

process: Verify the original complaint is resolved (retest, clear codes, road test).
Check that no new warning lights, noises, or leaks are present.
Confirm all fasteners, covers, and components are properly reinstalled.
Sign off on the quality check and update the work order status.

steps.description: Close the work order, generate the invoice, and prepare the vehicle for customer pickup.

inputs.name: quality-check-result
inputs.desc: Quality check pass or fail result

inputs.name: repair-log
inputs.desc: Actual parts and labor for invoicing

outputs.name: final-invoice
outputs.desc: Invoice with actual parts, labor, taxes, and total

outputs.name: work-order-record
outputs.desc: Completed work order with all documentation

process: Generate the invoice from the actual parts used and labor time.
Apply any discounts, coupons, or warranty credits.
Move the vehicle to the ready area and note the parking location.
Notify the customer the vehicle is ready for pickup.

description: Maintain vehicle service history records, track the manufacturer maintenance schedule, and generate upcoming service reminders.

steps.description: Record a service visit with date, mileage, services performed, parts used, and technician.

inputs.name: vehicle-identifier
inputs.desc: VIN or internal vehicle ID

inputs.name: service-details
inputs.desc: What was done, parts used, technician name, date, and mileage

outputs.name: service-record
outputs.desc: Formatted service record entry

outputs.name: updated-history
outputs.desc: Vehicle history with the new entry appended

process: Look up the vehicle in the system by VIN or internal ID.
Record the visit date, current mileage, services performed, and parts installed.
Note the technician who performed the work and any warranty information.
Append the record to the vehicle history.

steps.description: Track the manufacturer maintenance schedule for a vehicle and flag overdue or upcoming items.

inputs.name: updated-history
inputs.desc: Current vehicle service history

inputs.name: vehicle-identifier
inputs.desc: VIN to look up the manufacturer schedule

outputs.name: schedule-status
outputs.desc: Each maintenance item with its status (current, due soon, overdue)

outputs.name: next-services
outputs.desc: List of services due at the next interval based on current mileage

process: Look up the manufacturer maintenance schedule for the vehicle year, make, and model.
Compare the service history against the schedule to identify completed, due, and overdue items.
Calculate the next service interval based on the current mileage and time.
Flag any overdue items for priority attention.

steps.description: Generate service reminders for upcoming maintenance based on the schedule and average driving patterns.

inputs.name: schedule-status
inputs.desc: Current maintenance schedule status

inputs.name: next-services
inputs.desc: Services due at the next interval

outputs.name: reminder-list
outputs.desc: List of reminders with target date, mileage threshold, and service description

outputs.name: reminder-messages
outputs.desc: Formatted messages ready to send to the customer

process: Estimate the date the vehicle will reach the next mileage interval based on driving history.
Generate a reminder for each upcoming service with the target date and mileage.
Format the reminder message for the customer with the recommended services and pricing.
Queue the reminders for the appropriate send date.

steps.description: Compile the full vehicle service history into a formatted report.

inputs.name: updated-history
inputs.desc: Complete vehicle service history

inputs.name: schedule-status
inputs.desc: Current maintenance schedule status

outputs.name: history-report
outputs.desc: Formatted vehicle history report with all service visits and schedule compliance

outputs.name: vehicle-health-summary
outputs.desc: Summary of the vehicle condition based on maintenance history

process: Organize the service records chronologically with mileage at each visit.
Highlight the manufacturer schedule compliance (on time, late, or missed).
Note any recurring issues or patterns in the service history.
Produce the formatted report suitable for the customer or for resale documentation.

description: Manage auto parts inventory including par levels, reorder points, supplier ordering, receiving, and core returns.

steps.description: Set par levels and reorder points for commonly used parts based on usage history.

inputs.name: usage-history
inputs.desc: Parts usage data by part number over the prior period

inputs.name: lead-times
inputs.desc: Supplier lead times for each part or category

outputs.name: par-levels
outputs.desc: Minimum stock level for each part number

outputs.name: reorder-points
outputs.desc: Stock level at which to reorder, accounting for lead time and usage rate

process: Calculate the average daily or weekly usage for each stocked part number.
Factor in the supplier lead time for each part.
Set the reorder point at the usage rate times the lead time plus a safety buffer.
Set the par level at the reorder point plus one standard order quantity.

steps.description: Generate and submit parts orders to suppliers when stock falls below the reorder point.

inputs.name: par-levels
inputs.desc: Minimum stock levels

inputs.name: reorder-points
inputs.desc: Trigger levels for reordering

outputs.name: purchase-orders
outputs.desc: Submitted purchase orders with part numbers, quantities, suppliers, and expected delivery dates

outputs.name: order-status
outputs.desc: Tracking status for each open order

process: Scan inventory levels against reorder points to identify parts that need ordering.
Group the needed parts by supplier for efficient ordering.
Submit the purchase orders and record the order numbers and expected delivery dates.
Update the inventory system with the pending orders.

steps.description: Receive parts shipments, verify against the purchase order, and stock the parts.

inputs.name: purchase-orders
inputs.desc: Open purchase orders to receive against

inputs.name: order-status
inputs.desc: Current order tracking status

outputs.name: receiving-record
outputs.desc: Record of parts received with quantities, condition, and any discrepancies

outputs.name: updated-inventory
outputs.desc: Inventory counts updated with received parts

process: Match the incoming shipment to the purchase order.
Verify the part numbers, quantities, and condition against the order.
Note any discrepancies (wrong part, short shipment, damage) and contact the supplier.
Stock the parts in the designated bin locations and update inventory counts.

steps.description: Track core returns and warranty claims for parts to recover credits.

inputs.name: updated-inventory
inputs.desc: Current inventory including cores awaiting return

inputs.name: receiving-record
inputs.desc: Receiving records with warranty-eligible parts noted

outputs.name: core-return-log
outputs.desc: Cores returned with tracking numbers and credit status

outputs.name: parts-inventory-report
outputs.desc: Summary of inventory value, turnover, and pending credits

process: Identify cores that need to be returned for credit within the supplier deadline.
Package and ship the cores with the proper return authorization.
Track the warranty claims for defective parts and their replacement or credit status.
Produce the inventory summary with total value, turnover rate, and pending credits.

description: Generate a repair estimate by looking up labor times, pricing parts, adding fees, and presenting the total to the customer.

steps.description: Look up the labor guide time for each repair operation on the specific vehicle.

inputs.name: repair-operations
inputs.desc: List of repair operations to estimate

inputs.name: vehicle-info
inputs.desc: Year, make, model, engine, and trim for accurate labor times

outputs.name: labor-times
outputs.desc: Labor guide hours for each operation

outputs.name: overlap-adjustments
outputs.desc: Time reductions for operations that share disassembly steps

process: Look up each repair operation in the labor guide (Mitchell, ALLDATA, or manufacturer).
Record the book time in hours for each operation.
Identify overlapping operations where disassembly is shared and apply time reductions.
Note any operations not in the guide that require a custom time estimate.

steps.description: Price the required parts from the parts catalog or supplier price lists.

inputs.name: repair-operations
inputs.desc: Repair operations to look up parts for

inputs.name: vehicle-info
inputs.desc: Vehicle information for accurate part fitment

outputs.name: parts-pricing
outputs.desc: Each part with part number, description, source, cost, and retail price

outputs.name: parts-availability
outputs.desc: Stock status and delivery time for each part

process: Identify the parts needed for each repair operation.
Look up the part numbers for the specific vehicle application.
Price each part at the shop retail rate (cost plus markup).
Check availability and note any back-ordered or special-order parts.

steps.description: Calculate the total estimate including labor, parts, shop supplies, taxes, and fees.

inputs.name: labor-times
inputs.desc: Labor hours for each operation

inputs.name: parts-pricing
inputs.desc: Parts pricing for each operation

outputs.name: estimate-total
outputs.desc: Total estimate broken down by labor, parts, supplies, tax, and fees

outputs.name: estimate-document
outputs.desc: Formatted estimate document ready to present to the customer

process: Multiply the labor hours by the shop labor rate for each operation.
Add the parts retail prices for each operation.
Add the shop supplies percentage and any environmental or disposal fees.
Calculate the tax and total, and format the estimate document.

steps.description: Present the estimate to the customer, answer questions, and record the outcome.

inputs.name: estimate-document
inputs.desc: Formatted estimate to present

inputs.name: estimate-total
inputs.desc: Total and breakdown for discussion

outputs.name: customer-decision
outputs.desc: Approved, declined, or approved in part with notes

outputs.name: estimate-record
outputs.desc: Final estimate record with customer decision and any modifications

process: Present the estimate to the customer in clear language, grouping by priority.
Explain the difference between needed repairs and recommended maintenance.
Record the customer decision (full approval, partial approval, or decline).
If partially approved, note which line items were authorized and adjust the work order.

description: Track technician productivity by comparing flag hours to clock hours, calculating efficiency, and identifying improvement opportunities.

steps.description: Log the clock time (hours present) and flag time (labor hours billed) for each technician.

inputs.name: technician-roster
inputs.desc: List of technicians with their schedules

inputs.name: reporting-period
inputs.desc: Date range for the productivity report

outputs.name: time-records
outputs.desc: Clock hours and flag hours for each technician in the period

outputs.name: job-breakdown
outputs.desc: Flag hours broken down by job type (maintenance, repair, diagnostic, warranty)

process: Pull the clock-in and clock-out times for each technician in the period.
Pull the flag hours (labor billed) from the completed work orders in the period.
Break down the flag hours by job type for each technician.
Exclude non-productive time (training, shop meetings, cleaning) from the clock hours if tracked separately.

steps.description: Calculate the efficiency rate and proficiency rate for each technician.

inputs.name: time-records
inputs.desc: Clock hours and flag hours for each technician

inputs.name: job-breakdown
inputs.desc: Flag hours by job type

outputs.name: efficiency-rates
outputs.desc: Efficiency (flag / clock) and proficiency (flag / available) for each technician

outputs.name: benchmark-comparison
outputs.desc: Each technician compared against shop average and industry benchmarks

process: Calculate efficiency rate as flag hours divided by clock hours for each technician.
Calculate proficiency rate as flag hours divided by available hours.
Compare each rate against the shop average and industry benchmarks (typically 100% to 125% efficiency).
Rank technicians by efficiency to identify top performers and those needing support.

steps.description: Identify the factors behind low productivity and recommend workflow or training improvements.

inputs.name: efficiency-rates
inputs.desc: Efficiency and proficiency rates for each technician

inputs.name: benchmark-comparison
inputs.desc: How each technician compares to benchmarks

outputs.name: improvement-recommendations
outputs.desc: Specific recommendations for technicians below benchmark

outputs.name: productivity-report
outputs.desc: Complete productivity report for the period

process: For each technician below benchmark, analyze the job mix to see if they are assigned low-flag work.
Check for patterns (slow on diagnostics, fast on maintenance, waiting for parts).
Recommend specific actions (training, tooling, workflow changes, job assignment adjustments).
Produce the complete productivity report with rates, trends, and recommendations.

description: Set up and manage a fleet service program including scheduling, tracking, billing, and cost reporting by vehicle.

steps.description: Set up the fleet account with vehicle roster, billing terms, and contact information.

inputs.name: fleet-details
inputs.desc: Company name, contact, billing address, and payment terms

inputs.name: vehicle-roster
inputs.desc: List of fleet vehicles with VIN, year, make, model, and unit number

outputs.name: fleet-account
outputs.desc: Configured fleet account with billing terms and authorized contacts

outputs.name: vehicle-records
outputs.desc: Individual vehicle records created for each fleet unit

process: Create the fleet account with billing terms (net 30, PO required, fleet discount rate).
Enter each vehicle into the system with VIN, unit number, and current mileage.
Set up the authorized contacts who can approve repairs.
Configure the billing method (per vehicle, consolidated monthly, PO-based).

steps.description: Schedule preventive maintenance for the fleet based on manufacturer intervals and fleet policies.

inputs.name: vehicle-records
inputs.desc: Fleet vehicle records with current mileage and last service dates

inputs.name: fleet-account
inputs.desc: Fleet account with maintenance policy preferences

outputs.name: maintenance-schedule
outputs.desc: Scheduled maintenance appointments for each vehicle over the planning period

outputs.name: schedule-conflicts
outputs.desc: Vehicles that cannot be scheduled without impacting fleet availability

process: Determine the maintenance interval for each vehicle (mileage-based, time-based, or both).
Calculate the next service date for each vehicle based on usage patterns.
Schedule appointments to minimize fleet downtime (stagger across dates).
Flag any scheduling conflicts where too many vehicles would be out of service at once.

steps.description: Track service history and costs for each fleet vehicle and the fleet as a whole.

inputs.name: maintenance-schedule
inputs.desc: Scheduled and completed maintenance events

inputs.name: vehicle-records
inputs.desc: Vehicle records to update with service data

outputs.name: fleet-service-log
outputs.desc: Service history for each vehicle with costs, dates, and work performed

outputs.name: fleet-cost-summary
outputs.desc: Total fleet maintenance cost by vehicle, by category, and over time

process: Record each completed service visit against the vehicle record.
Track costs by category (preventive maintenance, repairs, tires, fluids).
Calculate the cost per mile and cost per vehicle for the fleet.
Identify vehicles with above-average maintenance costs for replacement consideration.

steps.description: Report fleet uptime, downtime causes, and maintenance cost trends.

inputs.name: fleet-service-log
inputs.desc: Complete service history for the fleet

inputs.name: fleet-cost-summary
inputs.desc: Cost data by vehicle and category

outputs.name: fleet-uptime-report
outputs.desc: Uptime percentage by vehicle and for the fleet, with downtime causes

outputs.name: fleet-program-document
outputs.desc: Complete fleet service program document with schedule, costs, and performance

process: Calculate the uptime percentage for each vehicle (days available divided by total days).
Categorize downtime by cause (scheduled maintenance, unscheduled repair, parts wait, accident).
Trend the fleet maintenance costs month over month.
Produce the fleet program document for the fleet manager.

description: Process manufacturer warranty claims from coverage verification through repair, documentation, submission, and payment tracking.

steps.description: Verify that the vehicle and the repair are covered under the manufacturer warranty.

inputs.name: vehicle-info
inputs.desc: VIN, mileage, and in-service date

inputs.name: repair-needed
inputs.desc: Description of the repair or component failure

outputs.name: coverage-determination
outputs.desc: Whether the repair is covered, the applicable warranty (bumper-to-bumper, powertrain, extended), and any exclusions

outputs.name: claim-requirements
outputs.desc: Manufacturer requirements for the claim (photos, measurements, failed parts retention)

process: Check the VIN against the manufacturer warranty database for coverage status.
Verify the vehicle is within the mileage and time limits for the applicable warranty.
Confirm the failed component or symptom is covered and not excluded.
Note the specific documentation requirements for this type of claim.

steps.description: Perform the warranty repair per the manufacturer procedure and document the work.

inputs.name: coverage-determination
inputs.desc: Confirmed warranty coverage details

inputs.name: claim-requirements
inputs.desc: Documentation and procedure requirements

outputs.name: repair-documentation
outputs.desc: Photos, measurements, failed parts, and technician notes per manufacturer requirements

outputs.name: warranty-labor-record
outputs.desc: Labor operations performed at the warranty labor rate and time

process: Follow the manufacturer diagnostic and repair procedure exactly as specified.
Take the required photos before, during, and after the repair.
Record any measurements the manufacturer requires (wear, clearance, voltage).
Retain the failed parts for the required period in case of manufacturer audit.

steps.description: Submit the warranty claim to the manufacturer with all required documentation.

inputs.name: repair-documentation
inputs.desc: Photos, measurements, and notes from the repair

inputs.name: warranty-labor-record
inputs.desc: Labor operations and parts used

outputs.name: claim-submission
outputs.desc: Submitted claim with the manufacturer claim number

outputs.name: expected-payment
outputs.desc: Expected payment amount and timeline based on the claim

process: Enter the claim in the manufacturer warranty system with the correct operation codes.
Attach the required documentation (photos, measurements, causal part number).
Submit the claim within the manufacturer filing deadline.
Record the claim number and expected payment amount.

steps.description: Track warranty claim payments and handle any rejections or adjustments.

inputs.name: claim-submission
inputs.desc: Submitted claim details

inputs.name: expected-payment
inputs.desc: Expected payment for comparison

outputs.name: payment-status
outputs.desc: Payment received, pending, adjusted, or rejected with reason

outputs.name: warranty-claim-record
outputs.desc: Complete claim record from submission through payment

process: Monitor the claim status in the manufacturer portal.
When payment is received, compare the actual amount to the expected amount.
If the claim is adjusted or rejected, review the reason and appeal if warranted.
Close the claim record with the final payment amount and date.

description: Manage the communication workflow for a repair shop from appointment confirmation through post-service review request.

steps.description: Send appointment confirmation and reminders to the customer.

inputs.name: appointment-details
inputs.desc: Date, time, vehicle, and services scheduled

inputs.name: customer-contact
inputs.desc: Customer name, phone, email, and communication preference

outputs.name: confirmation-sent
outputs.desc: Confirmation message sent with delivery status

outputs.name: reminder-schedule
outputs.desc: Scheduled reminders (24 hours before, morning of) with send times

process: Send the appointment confirmation via the customer's preferred channel (text, email, phone).
Include the date, time, vehicle, and services scheduled.
Schedule a reminder for 24 hours before the appointment.
Schedule a morning-of reminder on the day of the appointment.

steps.description: Notify the customer when the diagnostic is complete and the estimate is ready.

inputs.name: confirmation-sent
inputs.desc: Prior confirmation for customer contact reference

inputs.name: customer-contact
inputs.desc: Customer contact information

outputs.name: update-sent
outputs.desc: Diagnostic update message sent with delivery status

outputs.name: authorization-request
outputs.desc: Request for customer authorization to proceed with the estimate

process: Compose the update message summarizing the diagnostic findings in plain language.
Include the total estimate amount and ask for authorization to proceed.
Send via the customer's preferred channel.
Log the outreach attempt and whether the customer responded.

steps.description: Send status updates during the repair to keep the customer informed.

inputs.name: update-sent
inputs.desc: Prior communication for context

inputs.name: authorization-request
inputs.desc: Customer authorization record

outputs.name: status-updates-log
outputs.desc: Record of all status updates sent during the repair

outputs.name: ready-notification
outputs.desc: Notification sent when the vehicle is ready for pickup

process: Send an update if the repair will take longer than expected or if additional work is found.
Notify the customer when parts arrive if there was a wait.
Send the vehicle-ready notification with the final total and pickup instructions.
Log all updates sent during the repair.

steps.description: Request a review from the customer after they pick up the vehicle.

inputs.name: status-updates-log
inputs.desc: Communication history for this visit

inputs.name: ready-notification
inputs.desc: Vehicle ready notification for timing the review request

outputs.name: review-request-sent
outputs.desc: Review request sent with link and delivery status

outputs.name: communication-record
outputs.desc: Complete communication record for this service visit

process: Wait an appropriate interval after pickup (24 to 48 hours).
Send a review request with a link to Google, Yelp, or the shop's review platform.
Include a brief thank-you and a way to contact the shop directly if there are concerns.
Close the communication record for this service visit.
